caption: The drawing depicts the corner of a two-story building viewed from below, rendered in sepia tones. The upper story features a wraparound balcony with a decorative metal railing, which extends along two visible sides of the building and is supported by angled braces beneath. On the left wall, there is a closed window with louvered shutters, while the right wall features a closed double door with small perforated decorations near the top. A downspout runs vertically along the right corner of the building. Above, the roof has a chimney with a cap and a small section of visible shingles. Below the balcony, on each side, there are two rectangular windows, one on each visible wall, both of which are shuttered or closed. The overall composition is linear and geometric, with clean lines and minimal shading, focusing on architectural elements.
title: Wrought Iron Balcony Rail
